objective: Measure the causal gap between accepted-grid event replay and the first controller-proposed next R-JF attempt, retaining accepted and rejected trial work.

frozen_event_policies.name: safety-first-development-diagnostic
frozen_event_policies.authority: diagnostic-only; selected from N=128+512 development evidence and not authorized for N=2048

causal_mapping.event_observation: after accepted R-JF step j completes
causal_mapping.runtime_target: the first subsequent R-JF attempt from the new committed state, before knowing whether that attempt will be accepted
causal_mapping.primary_diagnostic: count and characterize events for which runtime_target is rejected before accepted_grid_target is reached

stop_conditions: any committed R-JF accepted trajectory drift
